title: Chapter 156 The Gold Devouring Demonic Bug Surrenders
content:
Chapter 156 The Gold Devouring Demonic Bug Surrenders

A stream of green blood dripped from the mouth.

"hiss……"

The gold-eating demonic insect let out a high-pitched roar.

"Damn humans."

After this roar, the size of the gold-eating demonic insect changed dramatically, and its momentum continued to rise.

This incident forced Wang Shuo and others to stop their attack and retreat.

The size of the gold-eating demonic insect suddenly increased to nearly 100 meters, occupying two-thirds of the entire cave.

And her boss level has directly exceeded gold, reaching a dangerous level that Wang Shuo has never seen before.

"Quickly retreat!"

Wang Shuo was horrified and immediately asked everyone to escape quickly.

With this terrifying transformation, Wang Shuo even felt that Gong Zheng couldn't withstand the opponent's blow.

It wasn't until he ran several hundred meters that Wang Shuo stopped with lingering fear.

Thinking that this passage is so narrow, it is impossible for the other party to chase him.

Wang Shuo was relieved.

Suddenly, Wang Shuo slapped his forehead and said angrily: "Oops, this must be a trick of the gold-eating demon insect."

"Let's go back and take a look."

Gong Zheng was walking at the front, and everyone returned cautiously.

When he returned to the cave just now, Wang Shuo was stunned.

Where is the figure of the gold-eating demonic insect?

Wang Shuo knew he had been fooled.

"Search, the other party will definitely not be far away! Don't let go of anything suspicious."

Seeing the gold-eating demon worm escaping, Wang Shuo instantly gained confidence, otherwise the opponent would not have escaped.

Not long after, someone shouted.

"Lord, there is a situation here."

Wang Shuo walked over quickly and found that in a fork in the road, there was a smaller cave, and a white chrysalis was lying on a small stone slab.

Seeing Wang Shuo coming over, Mira knew that she could not escape this disaster.

"Are you really going to kill them all?" Mira's voice was full of pleading!

Wang Shuo was not careless. He looked at her from a distance and was not moved by her plea.

"It's useless to talk more. I'll give you a good time!" Wang Shuo looked determined.

Wang Shuo felt that he was not qualified to pity a bug, and it was also a golden boss.

"Wait a minute."

Mira shouted urgently, her voice full of reluctance.

She was definitely not willing to accept it. She had spent such a huge price and thousands of years to be reincarnated and resurrected. How could she be willing to die just like that?

"I am willing to surrender to you!" Mira said word by word, and even a line of clear tears flowed from her two small eyes.

Despair, unwillingness, humiliation!

She was originally a spiritual insect raised by the Black Dragon King. When the Black Dragon City was destroyed, she naturally could not escape the fate of death.

But for some reason, she was transformed into an undead spirit. After going through a lot of hardships, she was reborn. She never wanted to die again, even if she just survived.

Wang Shuo raised his eyebrows and seriously considered her proposal.

"What are you good for?"

If it's of little use, Wang Shuo doesn't mind avoiding future troubles.

Seeing Wang Shuo's serious expression, Mira was a little scared. She had only experienced this emotion twice.

The first time was when her intelligence was not yet developed, when she and her own kind were fighting day and night, and the second time was when Black Dragon City was destroyed and she was killed.

"I can refine ore, and the offspring born from my eggs will all be excellent miners."

When Wang Shuo heard this, he was already moved. Mining ore was inherently a laborious task. If Zerg could be used to mine, it would definitely be better than using manpower.

However, Wang Shuo's face remained calm.

"How do I ensure your loyalty?"

"Can I sign a master-servant contract with you?"

Is there such a thing?
